notes: This contract records the provider- and FOM-independent C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 enumeration families. It verifies that every imported standard enumeration exposes the expected number of distinct values. It is an API contract check only and does not claim provider behavior or cross-RTI interoperability.

api_surfaces.signature: Standard enumeration constants for callback, order, resign, save, restore, service-group, settings, synchronization, and authorization results
